parsed.name: small_cap_catalyst_wls_oct_nov_2026
parsed.strategy: Bet that the Oct 12-Nov 13 window is long enough only to monetize dated events, so every name has a confirmed or primary-sourced catalyst inside or just after it: semicap earnings (ASML Oct 14, TSM Oct 15, TER Oct 27), European defense/gambling prints (Saab and Evolution Oct 23, Kongsberg Oct 29), Hon Hai Tech Day Oct 30-31, and a dense FDA PDUFA cluster (MRK Oct 10, AGIO Nov 1, SMMT Nov 14, BBIO Nov 27, COGT Nov 30, VRTX Nov 30, CORT Dec 17, GILD Dec 23). I avoid names where revision_flow_90d is negative (ALB -12, FLUT -15, CEG -6, SMR -6, LEU -4, OKLO -4) and the thin small caps where cost_bps of 35 eats the edge. I would be wrong if a single macro shock or a de-escalation headline hits the whole book at once, or if the PDUFA cluster delivers CRLs rather than approvals.
parsed.objective: Maximize relative P&L versus the Bloomberg WLS index from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13 with a long-only book of dated-catalyst small/mid/large caps.
